info.name: BuiltWith Change Bulk Processing Technology Changes API

params.name: LOOKUP
params.description: Single domain or comma-separated list of domains

params.name: SINCE
params.description: Time window for change detection; natural language or ISO 8601 date

items.docs: Returns technology additions and removals for one or more domains, with optional SINCE parameter to scope the detection window. AI-generated summaries explain the business significance of each change. 1 API credit per domain with changes; no charge for domains with none.
